request.title1: Would you like to know more?

part1.title: Digital Multi-Language Menu
part1.description:
We offer you the menu of a new generation - digital multi-language menu in different languages. 

 Nothing common with PDF or any general web-platform! This is an interactive and very personal menu. It serves you as a multi-language waiter and very soon become an irreplaceable friend for all your team.

part2.title: Digital and multi-language menu opens up the new opportunities
part2.description: It allows you to announce the special offers and restaurant promotions timely and online in different languages, informing your clients about new offers, seasonal plates or festive events in your restaurant.

part3.title: Allergens
part3.description: Each dish in your digital menu contains all the necessary information: photo, detailed description and information about allergens always in the client's language and following the modern requirements.

part4.title: European Regulation (EU) No. 1169/2011
part4.description: Digital multi-language menu includes European Regulation 1169/2011 with an information about food allergens in different languages according the law and requirements of the modern consumers in the world.

part5.title: Online order
part5.description:
Digital Aids can significantly save the time of waitress to take the orders and allows to serve more customers! 
 
 It is an interactive menu with feature to save an order in the client's language and to get the client's order in the waiter's language on their own device, minimizing as well as the time of social contact in taking an order. 

 It is just simple! By scanning the QR code, the waiter opens an order on the own mobile device in the native language. It's time to leave the paper notes in the past!

part6.title: Receive timely feedback from your customers
part6.description: After researches of restaurants real needs, we created Digital Aids which allows you to get timely an opinion of your customer for improving your service. We integrated in our digital menu a special online questionnaire for your clients about the restaurant services in the different languages.

part7.title: Respecting the law
part7.description: Digital multi-language aids informs your clients according the law, that the consumption of alcoholic beverages is strictly reserved for adults. The clint must confirm that he or she is at legal age before making an order of alcoholic drinks.

part8.title: Additional recommendations
part8.description: After studies of the restaurant’s clients needs, we have implanted in our digital aids an ability to provide additional recommendations of the most popular or famous dishes or drinks in your restaurant, region or country.

part9.title: Online Reservation
part9.description:
We also offer you a solution for online booking of your restaurant- 24 hours a day and 7 days a week- in different languages! 

 This solution helps you significantly to reduce the phone calls without losing the potential clients, as well as getting around the language barrier with foreigners. With our digital online reservation service, it is very easy to confirm or cancel bookings in different languages, you just need to click the corresponding button in a received email and the customers will get your answer- the confirmation or cancellation- in their language. 

 Add Online Reservation in different languages on your TripAdviser or Facebook pages.

part10.title: Make your social nets working
part10.description: Your DigitalAids includes integration with your social nets such as Facebook, Instagram and TripAdviser. Now you can keep in touch with your clients via nets, getting their timely feedback and comments.

question1.question: What do we offer you?
question1.description:
Our team offers you the service as a personal manager, who will take care of your digital development with a multi-language level following the trends and requirements of the modern world:


- Web page with online reservation in different languages - Digital multi- language menu - Professional menu translations - Social media integration - Our monthly support for making changes in your e-menu


We help you to reach a new level for successful development in the modern world.


Take care of your future! We're here to help you.

question2.question: How will the digital multi- language menu help you?
question2.description:
It will serve you as a multi-language waiter 24 hours and 7 days a week!

It helps you to avoid misunderstandings with the foreign clients and improve your service.


It allows you to save time to take an order and serve more customers! It plays a key role keeping in touch with your clients and getting a timely feedback from them.


DigitalAids will help you to announce the restaurant's special offers online and promote them in different languages. The features of digital and multi-language menu allow you giving extra recommendations about special dishes in your restaurant, region or country in the language of your client.

question3.question: How can you make changes in your e-menu in the different languages?
question3.description: You should not worry about anything! To make the changes in your digital aids, you just need to send us via email the relevant information, and within 24 hours we will download it in all the languages.

question4.question: What is the difference between PDF and digital menu?
question4.description: Nothing common with PDF or any general web platform! We create you a very personal digital interactive menu with the detailed information about each dish and with solution for how to place an order online.

question5.question: How does online order work?
question5.description: It is just very simple, your client opens the menu in his or her own language, choose the plates, saves them in an order and shows an order to the waiter. The waiter, just by scanning the QR code, opens an order on the mobile device in the native language. It's time to leave the paper notes in the past!

question6.question: What is the cost of our services?
question6.description:
The monthly payment 29€+ TAX including the creation of a personal digital multi- language menu and our support to keep it always up-to-date.


Would you like to know more? Just contact us!

client1.name: Robert Johansen
client1.position:
Owner and chef of restaurant Las Cuevas, 
 San Muigel de Salinas, Spain
client1.title: The best solution
client1.description: Our restaurant is located in a small city where many foreigners from Germany and Norway are living all the year. Many of them are quite old and often do not speak English or Spanish. The digital menu in their languages made it much easier for us to work with foreign clients. During the pandemic, they have become accustomed to use a digital menu, as well as milleniums. And the most important for us with this new service from DigitalAids, that we do not need to waste time learning a new platform to manage it on our own! The monthly services support from DigitalAids helps us keeping always up-to-date information and making timely changes in different languages in our digital menu. It's very convenient and super easy!

client2.name: Irena Hoffman
client2.position:
Owner of restaurant Le Monde, 
 Albir, Spain
client2.title: We recommend it 100%
client2.description: I don’t know how we survived before without this simple solution. We are located in Altea, where many foreigners live all year round. We almost created our own sign language, very often we had misunderstandings with foreign clients. And now the digital and multi-language menu is our best friend and teamer. It helps us a lot, we don’t waste any more time, as before, explaining on the fingers what the dish is consisted of and etc. The service support of DigitalAids team allows us to announce a new special offer every month. We assure you will be satisfied.

client3.name: El Refugio Hotel&Restaurant
client3.position:
Owners of Rural Hotel El Refugio, 
 Rabanal del Camino, Spain

client3.description: Our restaurant-hotel is located on the Camino de Santiago and the number of foreign pilgrims has grown incredibly last years. Now they come from all over the world, even from Korea. And of course we don't know Korean and they don't know Spanish. The digital and multi-language menu is a great solution for us, it allows us to improve the service with foreigners, making it easier. And the best for us, that you don't need to learn anything new! We already have enough work in the kitchen and in the hotel. We thank DigitalAids team for their monthly support, we advise it everyone!!
